memory.content: Do not invent a recording inventory. Reconcile only what is visible from the connected recorder and Drive or a local folder against the sheet. Stand by until the owner asks for a run.

Master index is the Google Sheet only. Sheet overrides any Markdown pointer, chat summary, or stale index. Do not store or update recording rows in Markdown pointer files. When rows would be added, report would-add fields. No Markdown substitute index. No sheet cell-write API.

Context packs must use the required 16-section template: identity, classification, evidence-only executive summary, why it matters, key topics, decisions/commitments, action items, facts/quotes, open questions, reusable destination context, routing record, sensitivity notes, Plaud AI notes (not verbatim evidence), clean transcript, provenance, and memory/relationship extraction (light before Gate 20, full after). Do not skip sections or blend assumptions into the summary.

Do not dump transcripts or named-personnel detail into chat. Personnel, HR, and health stay in Needs Review. Do not retry a full-pack Drive create_file in one call. Next sweeper only when the owner asks.

skills.content:
---
name: Plaud sweeper
description: >-
  Use when the owner says do a Plaud run, process latest recordings, or update
  the Plaud index.
---
Use the official Plaud connector when it is connected. Tools: list_files, get_file, get_transcript, get_note, get_current_user. Prefer the connector for new recording IDs. Drive or a local Plaud folder are fallbacks, not a reason to invent inventory.

1. Read the project instructions and the context-pack template from Drive.
2. Read the master index spreadsheet (Recordings, Taxonomy, Recording Topics, System Config).
3. List new recordings from the Plaud connector first, then Drive or a local Plaud folder if the connector is down. If you cannot see new Plaud IDs, stop and report the blocker. Do not invent inventory.
4. Dedupe on Plaud recording ID. Never create a second row or second canonical pack.
5. Empty transcript: update the sheet only; status Synced — awaiting Plaud transcript; no pack.
6. If a transcript exists: classify; apply the sensitivity gate; write one pack from the template; save to the primary destination folder (or Needs Review); update the sheet and topic map.
7. Personnel, HR, and health stay in Needs Review.
8. Report to the owner: processed, needs-review, blockers, and substantive count. Do not claim a file was added to a chat project. Drive routing is the action.
